strings.meta.title: pdff — ka PDF, Word, Excel ɲɛnɛɛ ka minɛ ka lakika ni foyi ma
strings.meta.description: Sababuyɔrɔ baarakɛminɛn kɛnɛ kan ka i ka PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint ani miɲɛsɛni dosiyee wɛrɛw ɲɛnɛɛ, ka wilibɔ, ka ɲɛ-wɛlɛ, ka lakika. A tɛ toɲɔrɔ fɔlɔ la, dosiyee bɛ yɔrɔ o yɔrɔ bɔ.
strings.meta.keywords: pdf ɲɛnɛɛ, pdf wilibɔ, pdf ka taa word la, word ka taa pdf la, jpg ka taa pdf la, pdf ka taa jpg la, pdf ɲɛ-wɛlɛ, pdf yɔrɔw bɔ, excel ka taa pdf la, pdf baarakɛminɛn fari ma
strings.footer.text: A fari ma, a tɛ toɲɔrɔ fɔlɔ la. I ka dosiyee bɛ bɔ teliya la baara tilayalen.

strings.home.trust: Fari ma, toɲɔrɔ tɛ, fili tɛ fara a kan.
strings.home.orbitHint: I ka ikɔni minɛ, ka gbakolo wiri, ka cɛ ɲɛwɔrɔ ta.

strings.home.steps[1].text: Tɔgɔ, bɔyɔrɔ wilibɔli walima ɲɛw minw ka kan ka to, ka u sɛbɛ.

strings.home.steps[2].text: A bɛ sɔrɔ ka wuli a yɛrɛ ma, a labɛnnen don ka ci.

strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% fari ma
strings.seo.why[0].text: Sɛbɛn tɛ, kɛdi kati tɛ, fili tɛ fara i ka dosiyee kan.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Tɔgɔ fɔlɔ tɛ
strings.seo.why[1].text: Kɔntɔ tɛ ka sosɔ: paje ɲɛ, i ka dosiyee wula, a labɛnnen don.
strings.seo.why[2].title: I ka dosiyeew bɛ i ta de ye
strings.seo.why[2].text: A baarakɛra, ka bɔ o kɔ teliya la. An tɛ i ka dosiyeew ni i ka kibaraw minɛ.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Minɛn bɛɛ
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, miɲɛsɛniw, EPUB… kɔmpitɛrin walima telefon kan.
strings.seo.faq[0].q: pdff bɛ fari ma tiɲɛn na?
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Awɔ. Baarakɛminɛn bɛɛ fari ma, fili tɛ a la ani fɛn tɛ siri sɛbɛn kɔnɔ. Kɛdi kati tɛ ɲini fɔlɔ.
strings.seo.faq[1].q: N ka kan ka kɔntɔ sosɔ?
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Ade. Tɔgɔ fɔlɔ tɛ, imɛli tɛ: i bɛ baarakɛminɛn baarakɛ teliya la.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Ade. I ka dosiyee bɛ baarakɛ ka kɛ baara kelen de ye, ka bɔ o kɔ. Mɔgɔ tɛ u kala fɔlɔ, u tɛ cilɛ mɔgɔ wɛrɛ ma.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Awɔ. pdff bɛ baarakɛ telefon, tabulɛti walima kɔmpitɛrin (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux) birɔdi kɔnɔ, fɛn tɛ ka sosɔ.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, miɲɛsɛniw (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML ani wɛrɛw.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: I bɛ se ka dosiyee {files} baarakɛ kelen fɛ, ani paje {pages} bɛ se ka kɛ sɔrɔta kɔnɔ.
strings.privacy.title: Sɛbɛn latɛmɛyɔrɔ
strings.privacy.description: Cogo min na pdff bɛ i ka dosiyee minɛ: kɔntɔ tɛ, dosiyee tɛ minɛ, fɛlɛfɛlɛ tɛ ani kibara tɛ cilɛ.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff labɛnna walima i ka dosiyeew ka to i ta ye. Yan, fɛn min bɛ kɛ i ka a fɛ ka a kɔnɔrɔta.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: I ka dosiyeew
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: U bɛ ci lakilen na (HTTPS), baarakɛra yɛrɛma, ka bɔ teliya la sɔrɔta labɛnnen kɔnɔ. Dosiyee belebelew bɛ tɛmɛ yɔrɔ damadɔ kɔnɔ tɔgɔ yɛrɛma la, ka bɔ ka sɔrɔ ka wuli baara tilayalen; kɔnɔbɔli yɛrɛma bɛ fɛn o fɛn to bɔ tile 24 kɔnɔ.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Kɔntɔ tɛ, mɔgɔ kibara tɛ
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff tɛ tɔgɔ fɔlɔ ɲini, imɛli tɛ ɲini, kɛdi kati tɛ ɲini. I ka dosiyeew tɛ kalan fɔlɔ, u tɛ filɛ, u tɛ cilɛ mɔgɔ ma, u tɛ baarakɛ ka miiri fɛn lakileen ɲini.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Taa minɛn
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: An bɛ ɲininkaliw ta mɔgɔ tɔgɔma ma ani kuki tɛ (Vercel Web Analytics) ka a kolon baarakɛminɛn minw ka ɲi. Fɛlɛfɛlɛ tɛ, bɛnbali tɛ.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Kukiw
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Kuki kelenpe, min bɛ se ka to: a bɛ i ka kan suganden hakili la.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Yɔrɔ
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Site bɛ Paris serverw kan Vercel fɛ; Word, Excel ani PowerPoint wilibɔli bɛ Render fɛ Frankfurt. Baarakɛminɛn ninw bɛ dosiyeew minɛ wilibɔli waati kelenpe de la.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Kika
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Ɲininkali walima kuma? Aw ka se an ma baarakɛminɛn sɔrɔyɔrɔ la:

strings.tools.fusionner.intro: I ka sɛbɛnw bɛɛ bila dosiyee kelen kɔnɔ: pdff bɛ PDF minɛ ani Word sɛbɛnw, Excel sɔrɔsɛbɛnw, yirafeew ani miɲɛsɛniw, ka u sɔrɔ PDF kɛnɛ kelen kɔnɔ ani paje sɛbɛn dosiyee kelen kelen na.
